scope: Exact GitHub Languages API byte totals for each proposed software/firmware repository. The predominant language is the largest byte bucket returned by GitHub, not necessarily a semantic summary of the executable core.

records.evidence: Exact byte map returned by the GitHub Languages API for spacebarchat/server on 2026-10-16. TypeScript is the largest bucket (2,476,425 bytes); the README identifies TypeScript as the primary backend implementation and C# utilities as additional components.

Exact byte map returned by the GitHub Languages API for eiln/ane on 2026-10-16. C is the largest bucket (47,841 bytes); the repository README describes the kernel module and libane user-space library, with Python bindings.

Exact byte map returned by the GitHub Languages API for jma24/mkmsbr on 2026-10-16. Rust is the largest bucket (140,107 bytes); the README and tree identify NASM/x86 boot-code sources as a substantial part of the project.
